stage: STAGE 3 — RESOURCE DISPOSAL CANNOT PASS VACUOUSLY

R1_empty_path.description: Resource with document_path='' must not vacuously become CLOSED

R2_none_path.description: Resource with document_path=None must not vacuously become CLOSED

R3_never_materialized.description: Path never existed on disk; must be NOT_MATERIALIZED

R4_materialized_disposal.description: Materialized directory physically deleted and verified absent -> CLOSED

R5_pre_existing_resource.description: Pre-existing resource (astra_created=False) must never be closed

R6_preserve_policy.description: PRESERVE_ON_FAILURE policy must mark SAVED, not CLOSED

R7_pid_reuse_protection.description: PID reuse detected via create_time mismatch -> abort and mark STALE_REUSED
